en.title: Shade Equity & Urban Heat Preparedness
en.summary: From official street-tree and sidewalk records to reproducible GIS evidence review — without inventing measured shade or planting priorities.
en.reviewNote: Spatial inventory is validated within its documented scope; ranked review candidates remain unavailable pending source measurement verification.
en.intendedUsers: Municipal public-data, GIS, pedestrian-infrastructure and urban-greening analysts reviewing source quality before planning field investigation.
implementedCapabilities: Official tree, sidewalk and tree-pit source integration
EPSG:3826 geometry validation and indexed spatial associations
Versioned snapshots and conditional evidence-review rules
Capacity/tolerance evidence and aggregate JSON/CSV briefings

sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: Street trees, pedestrian facilities and urban greening records are spread across official datasets. A tree map does not establish measured sidewalk shade, physically available planting sites, pedestrian thermal discomfort, spatial comparability or which observations warrant field verification.

Tree inventory → Spatial association → Data comparability → Field investigation → Potential policy action. This independent engineering POC reaches spatial inventory and evidence-readiness analysis, not measured shade deficits or planting feasibility. Intended users are municipal public-data, GIS, pedestrian-infrastructure and urban-greening analysts checking evidence before field investigation.

sections.title: Decision Readiness: Validated Inventory and a Closed Ranking Gate
paragraphs: Validated GIS Inventory: 14,896 features
Eligible Priority Candidates: 0

The official SW_LENG_ItemValue field has an unverified measurement definition and units. All lengthM and widthM values remain null; measurementVerified is false. A general survey specification does not certify this export-specific pedestrian-length denominator. Polygon perimeter and area/width are not validated substitutes.

Every one of the 14,896 inventory units has invalid_measurement_definition for prioritization. Normalized per-kilometre density and low-recorded-tree ranking remain unavailable. This is deliberate evidence validation, not an algorithm defect, zero survey demand or proof that Taipei lacks planting opportunities. Do not publish a misleading ranking simply because an algorithm exists.

The completed product still supports source-quality inspection, GIS reconciliation, spatial associations, ambiguity review, geographic coverage, provenance, reproducibility, validation and briefing export. Ranked field-survey recommendations await measurement and coverage verification.

sections.title: A Separate Analytical Module in the Existing Map
paragraphs: Taipei Bin Map already provides public-amenity mapping, facility discovery, Protected Trees records, Bin Allocation Decision Support and source-governance/policy-priority workflows. Shade Equity adds the separate #/shade-equity module with official roadside trees, sidewalks and tree pits, projection/topology checks, indexing, unique associations, ambiguity handling, snapshots, conditional rules, capacity/tolerance comparisons and aggregate briefings.

The Protected Trees legal subset is not substituted for the citywide roadside-tree registry. Shade Equity and Case 001 Bin Policy share one taipei-bin-map project intentionally, with independent populations, methods and versions. Existing bin baseline, Mode A/B, monitoring, publication gates and weights are preserved.

sections.title: Official Sources and Admission Stages
paragraphs: A — Roadside trees: 90,358 raw rows → 89,860 GIS-admitted registered observations, with EPSG:3826 coordinates, tree IDs, district, species and recorded measurements. Height/diameter units are not fully established; implausible source values remain quality flags, not canopy estimates. The shared UpdDate 2026-10-19 15:14:27 is an export update, not proof each tree was surveyed then. Survey timestamps, resource update, retrieval and processing are distinct.

B — Sidewalks: 15,053 raw MultiPolygon features → 14,896 admitted inventory units. There are 14,165 unique raw official IDs; repeated IDs can describe distinct geometries. EPSG:3826 polygons retain road side and district context. They are not pedestrian-network routes, and unverified SW_LENG_ItemValue cannot become a walking-length denominator.

C — Tree pits/planters: 56,720 raw MultiPolygon features include 50,904 explicitly classified 樹穴 records and 5,816 flowerbeds. Only pits enter the pit population, yielding 50,730 GIS-admitted pit observations. A recorded pit is not a vacancy; proximity does not prove a tree occupies it, and an unmatched pit is not a planting opportunity.

D — Park information: 813 context-only records, 0 admitted to sidewalk associations by scope, not zero parks. Park area is not canopy area, and a park centroid is not a measured tree-lined path. E — Historical greening: 45 context-only annual rows actually downloaded for 1981–2025, not the catalogue's 1977 start. No annual change is interpreted as verified tree removals or a cutting history.

F — Measured canopy and pedestrian heat exposure are unavailable for segment-scale analysis. No sufficient adopted source establishes measured shade fraction, segment canopy, pedestrian thermal exposure, street-specific air temperature or predicted cooling. Missing fields are unknown, not zero. Station climate data and educational context do not justify assigning heat to sidewalks.

A–C are limited source populations supporting their qualified GIS inventory role; that classification does not waive measurement eligibility. D/E remain context_only; F is unavailable. Retained official district boundaries have their own provenance and support containment, not a new tree/pit/bin population or guaranteed complete-city coverage.

sections.title: GIS Engineering: From Valid Geometry to Auditable Relationships
paragraphs: Analysis uses TWD97 / TM2 EPSG:3826 projected metres (easting, northing). WGS84 conversion serves map display and administrative checks; latitude/longitude degrees cannot be used directly as metre distances. A conservative projected envelope is followed by official district-boundary checks, so envelope membership alone does not establish city membership.

Closed rings, positive area, self-intersections, holes and MultiPolygon parts are validated. District consistency checks sidewalk vertices; unresolved boundary crossing/touching is excluded. Stable sidewalk identity combines the official ID with the first 12 SHA256 hex characters of canonical projected geometry. Canonicalization ignores ring starting point/direction and part ordering while retaining holes and distinct features.

A 100-metre bounding-box grid narrows candidate checks instead of comparing every tree with every polygon. Exact checks prefer unique strict containment. Without containment, a unique bounded-proximity association may use the default frozen 2 m tolerance. Multiple containing/nearby polygons and boundary hits stay ambiguous; no arbitrary opposite-road-side assignment occurs.

Pit representatives alone are insufficient: the full pit polygon must pass containment, including sidewalk holes. Unique tree/pit assignments count each observation once; ambiguous appearances retain review relationships but are non-additive. No geometry simplification changes analytical relationships, no street network is inferred, and map navigation vertices are not imagined planting coordinates.

Geometry and population exclusions remain separate: sidewalk exclusions are 4 invalid geometries, 2 canonical duplicate geometries and 151 district mismatches. Tree exclusions are 22 repeated-coordinate accounting exclusions, 455 district mismatches and 21 outside/boundary observations; these do not prove duplicate physical trees. Of 50,904 classified pits, 174 district mismatches leave 50,730 admitted. The 5,816 flowerbeds are excluded by population, not invalid geometry.

At 2 m, 89,860 admitted trees partition into 45,559 uniquely matched, 44,274 unmatched and 27 ambiguous; 3,729 unique matches use bounded proximity. The 50,730 admitted pits partition into 46,109 uniquely matched, 480 unmatched and 4,141 ambiguous. These are administrative spatial associations, not trees proven to shade sidewalks, vacant/occupied pits, measured canopy or people protected.

sections.title: Offline GIS and Lightweight Browser Architecture
paragraphs: Node.js performs source acquisition, original-byte validation, projection/topology/district checks, spatial indexing and large joins before deployment. Reviewed static snapshots contain precomputed associations; the lazy-loaded React/Leaflet module renders metadata, selected district detail, filters, map/table inventory and scenario explanations.

Citywide browser metadata has no individual segments and names twelve district chunks. Selecting one district loads only its validated chunk, checking snapshot/district identity and segment contracts. Loaded detail/exclusion counts are labelled by scope, rather than mistaken for citywide totals. Raw CSV/geometry never enters browser scenarios; Portfolio embeds none of these datasets or the GIS engine.

sections.title: Conditional Evidence-Review Methodology
paragraphs: shade-equity-evidence-review-v1, configuration 1.0.0, reviews one admitted official sidewalk polygon feature, not a road-network edge, tree pit, proposed planting point or approved site. Mandatory identity, district, geometry/display bounds, source and verified positive-length gates precede tier assignment. Every real feature currently fails measurement admission.

Independent material questions are matched across both dimension and causal source/problem ID using maximum bipartite matching. Several symptoms of one failure or repeated questions in one dimension cannot inflate priority. Globally missing canopy, unknown planting feasibility and generally unknown pit occupancy remain shared limitations, not priority points in every row.

Only comparable numerators and verified denominators within the same eligible units could support treeCount × 1000 / lengthM. A partial tree population divided by all-city sidewalk length is prohibited. The conditional low-recorded strategy has no implemented bottom-quartile threshold and is disabled on the real source; no lowest-25% result is published.

sections.title: Recorded Actual Capacity Results and Inventory Tables
paragraphs: Actual outputs use derived snapshot shade-equity-v1-8e4cfb4029d0831d, method shade-equity-evidence-review-v1, configuration 1.0.0, generated 2026-10-20T00:41:41.554Z. Source snapshot: shade-source-v1-078b91443dc33e45. All represented districts; frozen tolerance 2 m; minLengthM 0; includeAmbiguous false. This recorded minimum differs from the UI default 20 m: both are analyst settings, not municipal standards.

Evidence-first capacity 5 selects 0 from 0 eligible; capacity 10 also selects 0. District-balanced capacity 5 remains 0, not demonstrated equity. Low-recorded-tree strategy is unavailable. All 14,896 units fail invalid_measurement_definition; additional ambiguous-association exclusion reasons overlap and must not be added to that population.

Increasing review capacity cannot repair source definitions. Zero eligible candidates is not zero trees, zero pits or zero survey demand. Synthetic fixtures exercise nonempty A/B/C ranking, capacity and distribution behavior only in tests, never as real Taipei selections. The following tables retain raw, admitted, matched and eligible stages separately.

sections.title: Tolerance Sensitivity: Different Evidence Scopes
paragraphs: Three actual offline 0/2/5 m association runs use identical frozen source bytes. Matched trees are 41,830 / 45,559 / 47,744; ambiguous trees 0 / 27 / 174. Matched pits stay 46,109 while ambiguous pits are 3,752 / 4,141 / 4,200. All three retain 0 eligible ranked candidates.

Tolerance changes accepted relationships and therefore changes evidence scope, not just policy strategy on an identical candidate population. Larger tolerance does not mean new trees appeared, canopy/shade improved, planting became feasible or more citizens were protected; 5 m is not established as better. Offline rebuilding/review is required, rather than relabelling old browser joins.

Capacity/strategy comparisons can share evidence scope; district, source/version/population, minimum length, ambiguity admission or tolerance changes are different scopes. Strict/permissive association and length settings cannot reopen the measurement gate. Neither identical selections nor rank changes demonstrate environmental benefit.

sections.title: Performance Evidence: Offline Timing Is Not Browser Latency
paragraphs: Upstream recorded Windows / Node v24.14.0 / Intel i5-13500 measurements: full validation/conversion about 15.5–16.1 seconds; 0 m and 5 m association runs reusing validated inputs about 2.0–2.1 seconds each. These are offline Node.js timings, not browser, physical-phone or interaction latency measurements.

Initial browser-facing metadata is 13,723 bytes before the selected district chunk, not total app/page/network transfer. Twelve district chunks preserve all admitted units. Precomputed joins, district loading and limited map rendering avoid full-city browser GIS work; no fixed page-load or mobile response target is claimed measured.

sections.title: Source Custody, Stable Identity and Reproducibility
paragraphs: Frozen originals use lossless gzip custody, actual resource IDs, original-byte SHA256/lengths, actual schemas, CRS, retrieval/processing timestamps, raw/admitted counts and exclusions. Expanded original bytes are checked before restoration. Live hash/resource mismatches reject replacement of known-good data; a changed source requires a new explicit review/version. Scoped Git byte preservation and exact-byte publication replay prevent newline conversion from silently changing evidence.

Source snapshot shade-source-v1-078b91443dc33e45 identifies original custody; derived snapshot shade-equity-v1-8e4cfb4029d0831d binds normalized analysis. Two independent full-source runs share full normalized SHA256 6683224b154200e9f321742c8f4c69d72cb0dabd4c805e3e6a8f9c21c097c3c6. This is distinct from an individual original-file hash or the small metadata-file SHA256; the identifiers are not interchangeable.

A/B/C resource IDs are 0e96f4b5-8f8c-4935-ae0b-b97b3d031c94, b11d6142-1d71-41d5-a843-7b7cfcea61ef and 3e2b359b-8dae-46e4-a747-5912d8743d0e. Original SHA256 values, dates and remaining resource identities are retained in pinned source-health and audit evidence; generation timestamp is not a tree survey date.

JSON/CSV briefings preserve snapshot/method/configuration, source hashes/dates, controls, questions, exclusions and unavailable states. Empty selections retain provenance and explanations; formula-like spreadsheet text is escaped. No canopy percentage, temperature, health grade, vacancy or approved planting coordinate is exported.

sections.title: Responsible Use and Unsupported Inferences
paragraphs: Independent engineering POC, not an official Taipei greening decision or completed planting recommendation system. Roadside-tree observations and inventory density are not measured canopy or actual shade coverage; missing canopy does not mean zero canopy. No segment-scale pedestrian heat exposure, urban heat-island measurement or demonstrated shade fairness is established.

Recorded pits are not verified vacancies or approved planting sites. Unmatched trees do not prove physical absence; unmatched pits do not prove vacancy. Survey dates differ from resource update timestamps. Unverified sidewalk length and incomplete/temporally different coverage prevent a defensible normalized density ranking; the real eligible shortlist is zero.

No tree-removal history, cooling benefit, health-risk estimate, mortality prediction or official planting approval is produced. Utility, ownership, soil, accessibility and site measurements remain field prerequisites. Spatial associations do not establish occupancy, shade, safety or ecological improvement.

sections.title: Recorded Upstream Engineering Verification
paragraphs: Pinned source delivery records 471 passing tests across 31 files, TypeScript/Vite production build, 160 full E2E cases passed with one browser worker, 2 Shade offline tests, 4 unchanged Bin Policy offline checks and 2 Shade project-base tests. Source restoration, independent normalized snapshot reproduction and desktop/mobile review are recorded. No new dependencies were required. These are upstream recorded results, not Portfolio executions of the source suite.

A prior two-worker browser run had 159 passes and Chromium ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE loading an unchanged error-boundary module. The final one-worker run passed by reducing host contention; this does not prove permanent removal of environmental flakiness. No standalone lint success or independently measured browser-latency result is claimed.

Merged source PR #19 is the current delivery record; the earlier handoff's inability to create a PR is historical. The following inspected upstream local verification screenshots show the real gated inventory/controls, not government operation or independently verified public deployment.

sections.title: What Reopens the Evidence Gate
paragraphs: Official Data → GIS Engineering → Source Governance → Evidence Eligibility → Reproducible Analysis → Responsible Decision Support. This fifth approach demonstrates when evidence is insufficient to publish recommendations, alongside Case 001's separate policy-weighted bin allocation.

A reliable system explains both how recommendations are generated and why a real source cannot yet support them. The completed evidence-readiness outcome is valuable without fictional shade maps or nonempty shortlists.

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 行道樹、人行設施與都市綠化紀錄分散於不同官方資料集。樹木地圖無法證明人行道實際遮蔭、可實際植樹位置、行人熱不適、空間可比較性，或哪些觀察需要現地核實。
樹木盤點 → 空間關聯 → 資料可比較性 → 現地調查 → 可能政策行動。此獨立工程 POC 達到空間盤點與證據整備分析，未量測遮蔭缺口或判定植樹可行性。預期使用者為現勘前查核證據的市政公開資料、GIS、人行設施及都市綠化分析人員。

sections.title: 決策整備：已驗證盤點與尚未開放的排序門檻
paragraphs: 已驗證 GIS 盤點：14,896 個圖徵
合格優先候選：0
官方 SW_LENG_ItemValue 欄位的測量定義與單位未經充分驗證。全部 lengthM 與 widthM 維持 null，measurementVerified 為 false。一般測量規範無法認證此匯出資料特定的步行長度分母；多邊形周長及面積除以寬度都不是已驗證替代值。
全部 14,896 個盤點單位均因 invalid_measurement_definition 不得進入排序。每公里標準化密度與低記錄行道樹排序仍不可用。這是刻意的證據驗證，不是演算法故障、現勘需求為零，或臺北沒有植樹機會的證明；不能只因已有排序演算法就發布誤導名單。
已完成產品仍支援來源品質檢視、GIS 調和、空間關聯、歧義查核、地理涵蓋、來源脈絡、可重現性、驗證與簡報匯出。正式排序現勘建議須等待測量與涵蓋範圍核實。

sections.title: 既有地圖中的獨立分析模組
paragraphs: 臺北清潔箱地圖既有公共設施地圖、設施探索、受保護樹木紀錄、清潔箱配置決策支援，以及來源治理／政策優先流程。樹蔭公平新增獨立 #/shade-equity 模組，整合官方行道樹、人行道與樹穴，完成投影／拓樸檢查、索引、唯一關聯、歧義處理、快照、條件規則、容量／容差比較與彙總簡報。
受保護樹木的法律子集合不替代全市行道樹名冊。樹蔭公平與案例 001 清潔箱政策刻意共用同一 taipei-bin-map 專案，但母體、方法與版本各自獨立；既有清潔箱基準、模式 A／B、監測、發布門檻及權重均保留。

sections.title: 官方來源與納入階段
paragraphs: A — 行道樹：90,358 筆原始列 → 89,860 筆 GIS 納入登錄觀察，含 EPSG:3826 座標、樹木 ID、行政區、樹種及已記錄量測。樹高／直徑單位未充分確立，不合理數值保留為品質旗標，不推算樹冠。共同 UpdDate 2026-10-19 15:14:27 是匯出更新，不證明每棵樹當日受調查；調查、資源更新、擷取與處理時間皆不同。
B — 人行道：15,053 個原始 MultiPolygon 圖徵 → 14,896 個納入盤點單位；原始官方 ID 唯一值有 14,165 個，重複 ID 可對應不同幾何。EPSG:3826 多邊形保留道路側別及行政區背景，不是人行路網路徑，未驗證 SW_LENG_ItemValue 不能當作步行長度分母。
C — 樹穴／花圃：56,720 個原始 MultiPolygon 圖徵，其中 50,904 筆明確分類為樹穴、5,816 筆為花圃。僅樹穴進入樹穴母體，最終納入 50,730 筆 GIS 樹穴觀察。有樹穴不代表空置，鄰近不證明樹木占用；未配對樹穴不是植樹機會。
D — 公園資訊：813 筆背景紀錄，依分析範圍不納入人行道關聯（0），不代表零座公園。公園面積不是樹冠面積，中心點不是實測林蔭人行路徑。E — 歷史綠化：實際下載 1981–2025 共 45 筆年度背景列，不從目錄的 1977 年起虛構資料；年度變化不解讀為已驗證移除量或砍樹歷史。
F — 實測樹冠與行人熱曝露在路段尺度不可用。未採用足以建立實測遮蔭比例、路段樹冠、行人熱曝露、街道氣溫或預測降溫的來源；缺值是未知，不是零。測站氣候資料與科普背景不足以支持分配熱曝露到人行道。
A–C 屬 limited 來源母體，支援經限定的 GIS 盤點用途，不能豁免測量資格。D／E 維持 context_only，F 為 unavailable。保留官方行政區界另有來源脈絡，僅支援包含檢查，不形成新樹木／樹穴／清潔箱母體，也不保證全市完整涵蓋。

sections.title: GIS 工程：從有效幾何到可稽核關聯
paragraphs: 分析使用 TWD97／TM2 EPSG:3826 投影公尺（東距、北距）。WGS84 轉換供地圖顯示與行政區檢查，經緯度的度數不可直接當公尺距離。保守投影包絡檢查後仍需官方區界驗證，通過包絡不等於位於市內。
檢查封閉環、正面積、自交、孔洞及 MultiPolygon 部件；人行道所有頂點須符合行政區一致性，未解跨界／觸界予以排除。穩定人行道身分由官方 ID 加上標準化投影幾何 SHA256 前 12 個十六進位字元構成。標準化不受環起點／方向或部件順序影響，仍保留孔洞與不同圖徵。
100 公尺邊界框網格縮小候選範圍，避免每棵樹與每個多邊形全面比較。精確檢查優先採唯一嚴格包含；無包含時，可在預設固定 2 m 容差內採唯一有界鄰近關聯。多個包含／鄰近候選及邊界命中保留歧義，不任意指派到道路另一側。
樹穴代表點不足以確認關聯，完整樹穴多邊形須通過包含檢查，亦須處理人行道孔洞。唯一樹木／樹穴關聯每筆只計一次；歧義出現保留待查關係，但不可相加為獨立觀察。不簡化幾何以致改變關聯、不推定街道路網，地圖導覽頂點也不是虛構植樹座標。
幾何與母體排除分開記錄：人行道排除 4 個無效幾何、2 個標準化重複幾何與 151 個行政區不符。樹木排除 22 筆重複座標保守計數、455 筆行政區不符及 21 筆外部／邊界觀察，不證明實體樹重複。50,904 筆分類樹穴中排除 174 筆行政區不符，留下 50,730 筆；5,816 筆花圃是母體排除，不是無效幾何。
2 m 下，89,860 筆納入樹木分為唯一配對 45,559、未配對 44,274、歧義 27，其中 3,729 筆唯一配對使用有界鄰近。50,730 筆納入樹穴分為唯一配對 46,109、未配對 480、歧義 4,141。這些是行政空間關聯，不是已證明遮蔭人行道的樹、空置／占用樹穴、實測樹冠或受保護人數。

sections.title: 離線 GIS 與輕量瀏覽器架構
paragraphs: Node.js 在部署前執行來源擷取、原始位元組驗證、投影／拓樸／行政區檢查、空間索引及大量關聯。經複核靜態快照保留預先計算關係；延遲載入 React／Leaflet 模組呈現中繼資料、選定行政區細節、篩選、地圖／表格盤點與情境解釋。
全市瀏覽器中繼資料不含個別路段，只列十二個行政區分塊檔名。選區後僅載入該區經驗證分塊，檢查快照／行政區身分及路段契約。已載入細節／排除數明示範圍，不誤作全市總數。原始 CSV／幾何不進入瀏覽器情境；作品集不內嵌這些資料集或 GIS 引擎。

sections.title: 條件式證據查核方法
paragraphs: shade-equity-evidence-review-v1，設定 1.0.0，查核單位為一個已納入官方人行道多邊形圖徵，不是路網邊、樹穴、提案植樹點或核准位置。身分、行政區、幾何／顯示邊界、來源及正值已驗證長度，皆為分級前必要門檻；所有實際圖徵目前未通過測量納入。
獨立重大問題以最大二分匹配，同時比對維度與原因來源／問題 ID。同一失敗多個症狀，或同維度重複問題，不能提高優先度。全域缺乏樹冠、植樹可行性未知及普遍樹穴占用未知，維持共同限制，不在每列加分。
僅在相同合格單位內，具可比較分子與已驗證分母，才可計算 treeCount × 1000 / lengthM。不得以部分樹木母體除以全市人行道長度。條件式低記錄策略未實作最低四分位門檻，且對實際來源停用，不發布最低 25% 結論。

sections.title: 已記錄實際容量結果與盤點表
paragraphs: 實際輸出採衍生快照 shade-equity-v1-8e4cfb4029d0831d、方法 shade-equity-evidence-review-v1、設定 1.0.0，產製於 2026-10-20T00:41:41.554Z；原始來源快照為 shade-source-v1-078b91443dc33e45。範圍為全部有資料行政區、固定容差 2 m、minLengthM 0、includeAmbiguous false。此記錄最小長度不同於介面預設 20 m，兩者皆為分析者設定，不是市府標準。
證據優先容量 5 從 0 個合格候選選取 0 個，容量 10 也為 0。行政區均衡容量 5 仍為 0，不代表達成公平。低記錄行道樹策略不可用；全部 14,896 個單位均因 invalid_measurement_definition 排除，其他歧義關聯理由可重疊，不可加成額外母體。
提高查核容量不能修復來源定義。零合格候選不是零樹木、零樹穴或零現勘需求。合成測試資料僅在測試中驗證非空 A／B／C 排序、容量與分布行為，不是臺北實際名單。下表分別保留原始、納入、配對與合格階段。

sections.title: 容差敏感度：不同證據範圍
paragraphs: 三次實際離線 0／2／5 m 關聯使用相同固定來源位元組。配對樹木為 41,830／45,559／47,744，歧義樹木 0／27／174；配對樹穴維持 46,109，歧義樹穴為 3,752／4,141／4,200。三者合格排序候選皆為 0。
容差改變接受的關聯，因此改變證據範圍，不只是相同候選母體上的政策策略。較大容差不表示新樹出現、樹冠／遮蔭改善、植樹更可行或更多居民受保護，亦未證明 5 m 較佳。必須另行離線重建與複核，不能只改瀏覽器舊配對的標籤。
容量／策略可比較同一證據範圍；行政區、來源／版本／母體、最小長度、歧義資格或容差變動則屬不同範圍。嚴格／寬鬆關聯及長度設定都不能重新開啟測量門檻。名單相同或名次改變，皆不證明環境效益。

links.label: 綁定來源的 0／2／5 m 容差證據

sections.title: 效能證據：離線時間不是瀏覽器延遲
paragraphs: 上游記錄 Windows／Node v24.14.0／Intel i5-13500：完整驗證／轉換約 15.5–16.1 秒；重用已驗證輸入的 0 m 與 5 m 關聯約各 2.0–2.1 秒。這是離線 Node.js 時間，不是瀏覽器、實體手機或互動延遲量測。
初始瀏覽器中繼資料為 13,723 位元組，之後再載入選定行政區分塊，不是整個應用／頁面／網路傳輸量。十二分塊保留全部納入單位。預先計算、依區載入及有限地圖呈現，避免全市瀏覽器 GIS 工作；未宣稱已量測固定頁面載入或手機回應目標。

links.label: 已記錄離線主機與時間證據

sections.title: 來源保存、穩定身分與可重現性
paragraphs: 固定原始資料採無損 gzip 保存，維護實際資源 ID、原始位元組 SHA256／長度、實際結構、座標系、擷取／處理時間、原始／納入數及排除理由。還原前檢查展開後原始位元組；即時雜湊／資源不符時，拒絕取代前次有效資料，變動來源需另行明示複核／版本。限定 Git 位元組保存及逐位元組發布重播，避免換行轉換暗改證據。

來源快照 shade-source-v1-078b91443dc33e45 識別原始保存，衍生快照 shade-equity-v1-8e4cfb4029d0831d 綁定正規化分析。兩次獨立完整來源執行的完整正規化 SHA256 相同：6683224b154200e9f321742c8f4c69d72cb0dabd4c805e3e6a8f9c21c097c3c6。此值不同於個別原始檔雜湊或小型中繼資料檔 SHA256，不可互換標示。
A／B／C 資源 ID 分別為 0e96f4b5-8f8c-4935-ae0b-b97b3d031c94、b11d6142-1d71-41d5-a843-7b7cfcea61ef、3e2b359b-8dae-46e4-a747-5912d8743d0e。原始 SHA256、日期及其他資源身分保留於固定來源健康與稽核證據；產製時間不是樹木調查日期。
JSON／CSV 簡報保留快照／方法／設定、來源雜湊／日期、控制項、問題、排除及不可用狀態。空名單仍保留脈絡與解釋，試算表公式型文字經跳脫。不匯出樹冠百分比、氣溫、健康等級、空置或核准植樹座標。

sections.title: 負責任使用與不支持的推論
paragraphs: 獨立工程 POC，不是臺北官方綠化決策或已完成的植樹建議系統。行道樹觀察與盤點密度不是實測樹冠或實際遮蔭覆蓋，缺樹冠資料不代表零樹冠；未建立路段行人熱曝露、都市熱島量測或已驗證樹蔭公平。
紀錄樹穴不是已驗證空位或核准植樹地點。未配對樹木不證明實體缺失，未配對樹穴不證明空置。調查時間與資源更新不同；未驗證長度及不完整／不同時期涵蓋，使標準化密度排序無法成立，實際合格名單為零。
未產生樹木移除史、降溫效益、健康風險估計、死亡預測或官方植樹核准。管線、所有權、土壤、無障礙與現地量測仍是現勘前提；空間關聯不證明占用、遮蔭、安全或生態改善。

sections.title: 上游已記錄工程驗證
paragraphs: 固定來源交付記錄 31 個檔案共 471 項測試通過、TypeScript／Vite 正式建置、單一瀏覽器工作者完成 160 項完整 E2E、2 項樹蔭離線測試、4 項未變更清潔箱政策離線檢查及 2 項樹蔭專案基底路徑測試。來源還原、獨立正規化快照重現與桌面／行動版複核均有記錄，未需新增依賴。這是上游結果，不是作品集執行來源測試套件。
先前雙工作者瀏覽器執行有 159 項通過，載入未變更錯誤邊界模組時遇 Chromium ERR_NO_BUFFER_SPACE。最終單工作者執行透過降低主機競爭而通過，不證明環境不穩定已永久消除。不宣稱獨立 lint 成功或已量測瀏覽器延遲。
已合併來源 PR #19 是目前交付狀態，早期交接無法建立 PR 的描述屬歷史。下列已檢視上游本機驗證截圖呈現實際受門檻限制的盤點／控制項，不是政府作業或獨立驗證公開部署。

sections.title: 重新開放證據門檻的條件
paragraphs: 官方資料 → GIS 工程 → 來源治理 → 證據資格 → 可重現分析 → 負責任決策支援。第五種方法呈現證據不足以發布建議的情況，與案例 001 獨立的政策加權清潔箱配置並列。
可靠系統同時解釋建議如何產生，以及實際來源為何尚不足以支持建議。已完成的證據整備成果，不需虛構遮蔭地圖或非空名單才能成立。
